channel.title: Tarn
channel.description: Updates for Tarn, a calm Mac menu bar app for focus and breathing.

item.title: Tarn 0.3.2
item.description:
More choice, and a gentler start.

  • Focus rounds can be any length from 1 to 180 minutes: choose Other in the length menu or in Settings, Focus. A new After a round setting lets a round simply stop, with no break
  • New Dock icons: choose Classic, Slate, Sage, Dusk, Sand or Night in Settings, General
  • Guided meditation now starts with a few quiet seconds of nature before the welcome is spoken
  • The Nature calm sound starts with the ocean

item.title: Tarn 0.3.1
item.description:
Updates that arrive on their own, if you want them.

  • Tarn now updates through Sparkle. It asks you once whether to check for updates automatically, then checks about once a week. You can also press Check for updates in Settings, General, and choose whether updates download and install by themselves
  • Checks go to GitHub and send no personal information, and every update is signed, with the signature checked before it is installed
  • If you are on 0.3.0 or older, download this version once by hand. After that, updates arrive through Tarn

item.title: Tarn 0.2.1
item.description:
A polish pass on the floating circle.

  • The ring now sits at the edge of the circle, with no dark band around it
  • The close button is a quiet small X until you hover, then it becomes a clear button
  • A little more room around the time at the small size, and a larger breathing picture
